editorial.tldr: Claude Opus 5.5 shipped Sep 22 on AWS and direct, an hour before OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna, and the launch coincided with 40-50% price cuts across vendors. Sonnet 5.5 followed Sep 28 with a lower cost per task.
editorial.whats_new: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5 on Oct 7, completing the 5.5 lineup with a fast, low-cost model to replace Haiku 4.5, which was nearly a year old.
editorial.why_it_matters: The 5.5 family now covers all three tiers, so model-routing and cost-per-task evals can be rerun across Opus, Sonnet and Haiku against the new price floor.
editorial.take_for_builders: Rerun your routing evals with Haiku 5.5 on the cheap tier and compare cost per completed task, not per-token price, against Sonnet 5.5.
